promptText: You murder someone you love or respect rather than let them expose you. Kill a Character. Check a Skill. If you have no living Characters, kill no one, and create a beloved mortal Character who you have betrayed.

experiences.text: I am Domenego Zulian, born in the Venetian parish of San Zulian in the year of Our Lord 1268; in my twenty-third year the Grand Council drove all the furnaces out of the city onto Murano for fear of fire, and I went with the fires, a glassblower with soot in his lungs and no name worth carving.

Marina Zulian holds her hand in the glory hole of The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie until the wardens admit no woman could fake such a burn for a lie; I bind her wrist in the water trough and say nothing, because Guild Silence is the only inheritance our father left me.
Fra Ludovico pays me in candle-ends and absolution for a phial of blood-red cristallo; Reading the Fire, I draw it out the instant the manganese clears, and he weeps at the colour of it.
I teach Piero Sagredo to row La Nona blind through the lagoon fog to San Michele, and when he asks what is wrapped in the wet sailcloth under the thwart I tell him it is sand.

The first hunger takes me at the wood-yard gate and I drink Piero Sagredo empty against the stacked billets, his tools still in my pocket; I row what is left out in La Nona and let it down into the channel off San Michele, and the fog takes it as easily as it took the sand.
Zoe Kalamare steps into the mouth of the furnace and beckons me after her, and when I take her hands in the fire my Glazed Hands come out cool while everything human in me burns off like dross.

characters.name: Marina Zulian
characters.description: my elder sister, who keeps the furnace accounts and forges our dead father's hand better than he ever wrote it

characters.name: Fra Ludovico
characters.description: a priest of Santa Maria e San Donato who buys my reliquary glass and asks nothing about the hours I keep

characters.name: Piero Sagredo
characters.description: my apprentice, gap-toothed and fourteen, who worships me and steals my tools

characters.name: Zoe Kalamare
characters.description: a Greek glass-factor out of Constantinople who has bought Murano cristallo for two hundred years without ageing a day; her hands do not burn

skills.name: Glassblowing
skills.description: I gather molten cristallo on the pipe and draw a goblet stem thin as a wasp's waist

skills.name: Reading the Fire
skills.description: I know a furnace's heat by the colour at its throat and never need to test it

skills.name: Guild Silence
skills.description: I keep the furnace secrets; under the Council's law a glassmaker who talks abroad loses his hands

skills.name: Bloodthirsty
skills.description: the hunger arrives before the thought does, and my hands are already moving

resources.name: The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie
resources.description: my father's glasshouse on Murano: three crucibles, a wood-yard, and a chimney that never goes cold

resources.name: The Book of Batches
resources.description: a soot-stained quire of recipes, Syrian soda ash and manganese in my father's proportions

resources.name: La Nona
resources.description: a flat-bottomed sandolo, tarred black, that I row across the lagoon by night

marks.name: Glazed Hands
marks.description: my palms are fused smooth and clear as cristallo where she held them in the fire; I wear a blower's leather mitts by day and by night
